code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from itertools import combinations
# ===========================================================================
# PROVENANCE: cysteine-register alignment of Der p 23 against mite group 12/
# 18/23 CBM14 domains and the chitin-binding CBM14 tachycitin; plus spatial
# test of whether the conserved polar/acidic residues form one surface patch
# on 4ZCE chain A.
# ===========================================================================
SEQ = {
 'Der p 23 (L7N6F8)'      : "DKFECPSRFGYFADPKDPHKFYICSNWEAVHKDCPGNTRWNEDEETCT",
 'Der f 23 (A0A088SAW7)'  : "EFECPTRFGYFADPKDPCKFYICSNWEAIHKSCPGNTRWNEKELTCT",
 'Blo t 12 (Q17282) Cterm': "VVCHEEGPIHIQEMCNKYIICSKSGSLWYITVMPCSIGTKFDPISRNCVLDN",
 'Lep d 12 (Q1M2L5) Cterm': None,   # filled from UniProt below
 'Der p 18 (Q4JK71) CBD'  : "CHQEGFFRDKTYCAKYYECKKGDFGLEQTVHHCPNHSQAFDEVSRTCVDHAKIPGC",
 'Der p 15 (Q4JK70) CBD'  : None,
 'tachycitin (P82107)'    : None,
}
def up_seq(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60)
    return "".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:])
lep=up_seq("Q1M2L5"); dp15=up_seq("Q4JK70"); tac=up_seq("P82107")
SEQ['Lep d 12 (Q1M2L5) Cterm']=lep[85:]
SEQ['Der p 15 (Q4JK70) CBD'] =dp15[475:]
SEQ['tachycitin (P82107)']   =tac
print("Lep d 12 C-term :",SEQ['Lep d 12 (Q1M2L5) Cterm'])
print("Der p 15 CBD    :",SEQ['Der p 15 (Q4JK70) CBD'])
print("tachycitin      :",tac,"len",len(tac))

print("\n=== cysteine inventory and inter-cysteine spacing (residues between Cys) ===")
inv=[]
for k,s in SEQ.items():
    cs=[i for i,ch in enumerate(s) if ch=='C']
    sp=[cs[i+1]-cs[i]-1 for i in range(len(cs)-1)]
    inv.append(dict(domain=k,nCys=len(cs),spacers=str(sp)))
    print(f"{k:26s} nCys={len(cs)}  spacers={sp}")
print()

# ---- register-anchored alignment on C1 / C3 / C4 / C5 (the 4 Cys Der p 23 keeps)
# Der p 23 numbering: C47=C1, [H61=C2 slot], C66=C3, C76=C4, C89=C5, [no C6]
anchors = {
 'Der p 23 (L7N6F8)'      : dict(C1=47, C2=61, C3=66, C4=76, C5=89, C6=None),
 'Der f 23 (A0A088SAW7)'  : dict(C1=48, C2=61, C3=66, C4=76, C5=90, C6=None),
 'Blo t 12 (Q17282) Cterm': dict(C1=95, C2=107,C3=113,C4=127,C5=140,C6=None),
 'Lep d 12 (Q1M2L5) Cterm': dict(C1=94, C2=None,C3=112,C4=126,C5=139,C6=None),
 'Der p 18 (Q4JK71) CBD'  : dict(C1=407,C2=419,C3=425,C4=439,C5=453,C6=462),
}
full={'Der p 23 (L7N6F8)':up_seq('L7N6F8'),'Der f 23 (A0A088SAW7)':up_seq('A0A088SAW7'),
      'Blo t 12 (Q17282) Cterm':up_seq('Q17282'),'Lep d 12 (Q1M2L5) Cterm':lep,
      'Der p 18 (Q4JK71) CBD':up_seq('Q4JK71')}
print("=== verification of anchor assignments (residue actually present) ===")
for k,a in anchors.items():
    s=full[k]
    print(f"{k:26s}", {n:(s[p-1] if p else '-') for n,p in a.items()})

print("\n=== residue at each register offset relative to C1 ===")
offs=list(range(0,30))
rows=[]
for k,a in anchors.items():
    s=full[k]; c1=a['C1']
    rows.append(dict(domain=k, **{f"C1+{o}": (s[c1-1+o] if 0<=c1-1+o<len(s) else '.') for o in offs}))
rt=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index('domain')
print(rt.to_string())
print("\nAromatic (F/W/Y/H) count in the C1..C5 span:")
for k,a in anchors.items():
    seg=full[k][a['C1']-1:a['C5']]
    print(f"  {k:26s} span={len(seg):3d}  F/W/Y={sum(c in 'FWY' for c in seg)}  +H={sum(c in 'FWYH' for c in seg)}"
          f"  aromatic density={sum(c in 'FWY' for c in seg)/len(seg)*100:.1f}%")

# ---- spatial test: do the conserved polar residues form one patch on 4ZCE? ----
pdb=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4ZCE.pdb",timeout=120).text
atoms={}
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[21]=='A' and l[16] in (" ","A"):
        el=(l[76:78].strip() or l[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
        if el in ("H","D"): continue
        atoms.setdefault(int(l[22:26]),[]).append((float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
def mind(i,j):
    A=np.array(atoms[i]); B=np.array(atoms[j])
    return float(np.linalg.norm(A[:,None]-B[None],axis=-1).min())
CONS=[47,50,56,57,59,66,76,84,85,88]          # id_para >= 70% in the paralog set
AROM=[51,54,69]                                # exposed aromatic patch from iteration 1
print("\n=== pairwise minimum heavy-atom distances (A) among conserved residues ===")
D=pd.DataFrame([[round(mind(i,j),1) if i!=j else 0.0 for j in CONS] for i in CONS],index=CONS,columns=CONS)
print(D.to_string())
print("\nconserved residues within 6 A of each other (contact graph edges):")
edges=[(i,j,round(mind(i,j),1)) for i,j in combinations(CONS,2) if mind(i,j)<6]
for e in edges: print("  ",e)
print("\ndistance from conserved acidic cluster to the exposed aromatic patch:")
for a in AROM:
    print(f"  F/W{a}: " + ", ".join(f"{c}:{mind(a,c):.1f}" for c in [50,84,85,88,56,59]))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
im=ax[0].imshow(D.values,cmap='viridis_r',vmin=0,vmax=20)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(CONS))); ax[0].set_xticklabels(CONS,rotation=90)
ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(CONS))); ax[0].set_yticklabels(CONS)
ax[0].set_title('Minimum heavy-atom distance (A) between\nconserved Der p 23 residues, 4ZCE chain A')
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax[0],label='distance (A)')
lab=list(rt.index); dens=[sum(c in 'FWY' for c in full[k][anchors[k]['C1']-1:anchors[k]['C5']])/
                          len(full[k][anchors[k]['C1']-1:anchors[k]['C5']])*100 for k in lab]
ncys=[sum(1 for n in ['C1','C2','C3','C4','C5','C6'] if anchors[k][n]) for k in lab]
ax[1].barh(range(len(lab)),dens,color=['#d62728' if n<6 else '#2ca02c' for n in ncys])
for i,(d,n) in enumerate(zip(dens,ncys)): ax[1].text(d+0.3,i,f"{n}/6 Cys",va='center',fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(lab))); ax[1].set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_xlabel('aromatic (F/W/Y) density in the C1-C5 span (%)'); ax[1].set_xlim(0,20)
ax[1].set_title('Mite CBM14 domains: aromatic content vs cysteine completeness\ngreen = full 6-Cys register, red = degenerate')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
